storybook-build.//inputs: mesma superfície do bundle vite de `build` + .storybook/** (main.ts/preview.tsx dirigem o que é buildado). Os primitivos + suas stories saíram para packages/app/ui (limpeza de identidade: @/components/ui/* → @codm/app-ui/*), mas `@codm/app-ui` é uma dependência DECLARADA de app-react (package.json) — nx resolve isso no grafo de projetos e `^production` (inputs de produção de toda dependência) inclui o src de app-ui automaticamente. É por isso que scripts/fidelity.ts NÃO precisa de --skip-nx-cache (o bk precisava porque suas stories moravam noutro workspace SEM essa relação de dependência declarada nos inputs).

test.//env: NODE_ENV IS PINNED, and it is a correctness fix, not hygiene. `bun test` defaults to NODE_ENV=test, but nx is launched from the REPO ROOT, where bun loads the root .env (NODE_ENV=development) — and an inherited value beats bun's default. The suite then meant two different things depending on where you launched it: `bun test` in this package = 270 pass / 6.95s; `bun run test` via nx = 267 pass, 3 FAIL, 15.9s. Bisected 2026-08-18: VITE_API_URL alone changes nothing, NODE_ENV=development alone reproduces all three failures plus the 2.3x slowdown, because React/Storybook composeStories/msw each branch on it — a dev-mode module graph is a different program under test. Previously misdiagnosed as a load-sensitive flake (the failing set moves, and one case lands within ~3ms of a timeout, which disguises it well); it is deterministic and single-cause. tests/setup.ts asserts the same invariant so a violation names itself in one sentence instead of surfacing as three unrelated story failures.
